The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

To explain the complex concept of blockchain technology using an analogy: Imagine a community notebook where everyone records their transactions. Instead of keeping this notebook in one person's house (which could be lost, stolen, or altered secretly), every single person in the village has an identical copy of the notebook. When someone wants to write a new entry, they shout it out to the village. Everyone checks their own notebook to make sure the new entry is valid and hasn't been recorded before. If the majority agrees it is correct, everyone writes it down in their own copy at the same time. Because everyone has a copy, no single person can secretly change a past entry without everyone else noticing and rejecting the change. This makes the record extremely secure and trustworthy, as it is decentralized (not controlled by one entity) and immutable (cannot be easily changed once recorded).
